debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr.

port.description: TCP port to listen on (commonly 9100 for raw printing; set to 0 for automatic port assignment).

host.description: Host/IP address to bind to (empty string binds to all interfaces).

bidir.description: Enable bidirectional communication to receive printer status (e.g., offline, paper jam).

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) before closing a connection (0 = no timeout).

init_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for printer initialization after connection.

keepalive.description: Enable TCP keepalive on client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections (often 1 for single-port printers).

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses (empty list = allow all).

items.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or CIDR range (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

denied_clients.description: List of explicitly denied client IP addresses (empty list = deny none).

items.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or CIDR range (e.g., '10.0.0.5').

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass directly to p910nd (e.g., '-f' to fork to background).
